newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai forex market to adjust trading on Deng.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai forex market to adjust trading on Deng.

text.p: The Shanghai-based China Foreign Exchange Trade System, an interbank market, will change its trading hours on Tuesday due to the funeral of late Chinese leader Deng Xiaoping, an exchange spokesman said on Monday.

Trading will start at 09:20 a.m. (0120 GMT) as usual but will be suspended for one hour from 10:00 a.m. (0200 GMT). The one-hour loss will be compensated for by trading from 11:00 a.m. to 12:00 midday (0300 to 0400 GMT), the spokesman said.
Beijing has announced that the funeral will start at 10:00 a.m. (0200 GMT) on Tuesday.
The Shanghai Metal Exchange will cancel trading sessions between 9:45 a.m. and 10:55 (0145 GMT and 0255 GMT), an exchange statement said on Monday.
But a spokesman for the Shanghai stock exchange said that the exchange would trade normally on Tuesday.
